scientific_intent.scientific_task: Evaluate a matrix-vector product whose weights are compressed into learned signed bit planes with per-group scales and optional offsets.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: y[m]=sum_k x[k]*(bias[group(k),m]+sum_b alpha[group(k),b,m]*sign(W[k,b,m])). Bit sign is +1 for set bits and -1 for unset bits. Alpha is learned per group, bit plane and output; it is not a fixed power-of-two integer quantizer.
scientific_intent.discretization: Seven legal even-output configurations: M34/514/2050,K64/128/256,8/4/3 planes, group sizes32/64/128, bias and no-bias, plus zero-input control. Source Ktile32 with bias,64 without bias, M_tile2048 and256threads retained.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Every output and actual input/guard value exact against independent dense integer weighted matvec. Dense quarter-integer inputs and half scales ±1/128 give all intermediate values exactly representable in half: absolute integer coefficient bound <=2048 on1/512 lattice. All32 packed bit positions active except explicit zero control.
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: One input vector, moderate output tails across one/two M tiles, one-to-eight K tiles, multiple quantization groups. Not full source large-shape CLI or batched general GEMM.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: True FP16 lookup sums, scaled accumulation and packed half2 atomics. Native selected SASS contains contracted HFMA2 despite separate PTX mul/add. Exact dyadic class makes contraction and atomic scheduling irrelevant here; arbitrary FP16 rounding and neural-model accuracy are outside certification.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Source NAVER LUT-GEMM compressed-weight inference operator, useful to study learned bit-plane lookup GEMV mapping. No end-to-end model quality, quantization calibration or production inference recommendation.
scientific_intent.description: Historical Julia source is dense Float32 matvec without packed planes, learned scales, offsets or LUT. Preserve it and restore actual source operator and shared lookup/packed atomic mapping in all Julia versions.
scientific_intent.provenance: Original source mv_fp16.h and kernels.cu, NAVER Cloud copyright2024 Apache2.0. Source headers and full originals archived. Independent oracle expands every packed bit directly; no LUT source reuse.

native_to_julia_mapping.reason: Same source LUT construction and packed byte lookup/output-pair half2 atomic reduction, same grid/block/tile settings. Native source functions unchanged. CUDA intrinsic FP16 instructions are backend extensions in all Julia models. JACC copies shared template before LUT fill; Julia fill! clear dispatch differs from native cudaMemset.

algorithm: Build256-entry shared half lookup for each8 input elements; source incremental expansion from32/64 columns. Sum4byte lookups per32 packed bits and learned plane scales for two outputs/lane, add optional offset term, packed half2 atomicAdd over K tiles. Clear output inside timed region.
work_item_mapping: 256 threads/block, each writes one base lookup column and its incremental expansions; two output channels per lane with stride512 inside M tile2048. K tile32biased/64unbiased, group aligned. M tails are even and native m+1 remains valid.
layout: Native row-major flattened LUT[KT/8][256], W[K/32][bits][M], alpha[groups][bits][M], offset[groups][M]. Julia identical linear layout and FP16x2 aligned adjacent outputs;8 guards each side of every allocated input/output, empty bias still guarded.
launch_geometry: Source block256; grid(ceil(M/2048),K/Ktile). Original selected source kernel bodies; initialization/device-only allocation harness scoped separately from original managed class/CLI.
verification_contract: All20 captures 319609 Float64 lossless typed words each: 156931 exact input prefix plus 162678 full output/input/guard fields. Exact all output values against independent integer dense bit expansion; actual payload byte identity and guards. Source original mean-error-only cuBLAS print checker not relied upon.
keyconfounds: Named dense exactly representable half fixture class; arbitraryhalf rounding or trained-model quality unverified
Source operator is learned-bitplane GEMV, not fixed2^bit INT8 dequantization or batched GEMM
Julia backend-specific truehalf arithmetic and packed half2 atomic; no pure portable implementation claim
Native defaultnvcc SASS fuses half operations; named dyadic proof avoids prescribing general contraction equivalence
Native cudaMemset versus Julia fill! output clear included inside timed scope; separate dispatch cost may differ
JACC whole shared-template initialization and entry barrier are extra work; explicit exact2048/4096 shared bytes
Shared reference/device helper authored in reference repair phase and reused KA then JACC; not independent cold-start translation costs
Historical Julia algorithm restoration is S1 reference work, not compiler rejection; first native host half-bit checker build rejection is T1 only
boundary_rounding_policy: Only evenM and K divisible selectedtile, group_size multiple selectedtile and dividingK. No oddM/partialK known-unsafe GPU run. Half sum/fma and packed half2 atomic, all accepted values exact on bounded lattice. Outputcanary+.5 reset outsideROI, clear0 insideROI, guard-123; no NaN pass.
support_boundary: One input vector, moderate output tails across one/two M tiles, one-to-eight K tiles, multiple quantization groups. Not full source large-shape CLI or batched general GEMM. True FP16 lookup sums, scaled accumulation and packed half2 atomics. Native selected SASS contains contracted HFMA2 despite separate PTX mul/add. Exact dyadic class makes contraction and atomic scheduling irrelevant here; arbitrary FP16 rounding and neural-model accuracy are outside certification.
interpretation: For compressed neural linear operators, bit representation, group scales and exact shared lookup/atomic semantics are necessary to compare the same work. Timings include required zeroing and are scoped to these seven cases; no dynamic FLOP/s, roofline, occupancy, trained-model accuracy or arbitrary quantization guarantee.
